def test_is_nested():
    # Nested brackets
    assert is_nested("[[]]") is True
    assert is_nested("[[[]]]") is True
    assert is_nested("[][[]]") is True
    assert is_nested("[[][]]") is True

    # Not nested
    assert is_nested("") is False
    assert is_nested("[]") is False
    assert is_nested("[][]") is False
